title: Signum times argument equals absolute value
statement:
For every real number $x$, the product of its sign and itself equals its absolute value:
$\operatorname{sign}(x)\cdot x = \abs{x}$, where $\operatorname{sign}(x)$ is $1$ if
$x>0$, $-1$ if $x<0$, and $0$ if $x=0$.
hypotheses_covered: x ranges over all real numbers
